cmd:
echo "NOW $(date -u)"
REPO=/opt/weather-pipeline/repo
mask(){ echo "...${1: -4}"; }
chk(){ code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: token $1" https://api.github.com/user); echo "$code"; }
echo "--- git-credentials (root)"
for f in /root/.git-credentials /home/ubuntu/.git-credentials; do
 [ -f $f ] && { tok=$(sed -E 's#https://[^:]*:([^@]*)@.*#\1#' $f | head -1); echo "$f tok=$(mask $tok) api=$(chk $tok) mtime=$(stat -c %y $f)"; }
done
echo "--- bridge token"
tok=$(cat /etc/vps-github-bridge/token 2>/dev/null|tr -d '\n'); echo "tok=$(mask $tok) api=$(chk $tok) mtime=$(stat -c %y /etc/vps-github-bridge/token)"
echo "--- repo .env tokens"
grep -E '^(GH_TOKEN|GITHUB_TOKEN|GITHUB_PAT)' $REPO/.env 2>/dev/null | while IFS== read k v; do echo "$k=$(mask $v) api=$(chk $v)"; done
echo "--- git config"
cd $REPO; git remote -v | sed -E 's#//[^@]*@#//***@#'; git config --get credential.helper; git config --global --get credential.helper
git status -sb | head -5; git log -3 --format='%h %cI %s' 
echo "--- fetch test"; timeout 40 git fetch --depth 1 origin main 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "--- ls-remote"; timeout 30 git ls-remote origin main 2>&1 | sed -E 's#//[^@]*@#//***@#' | tail -2
echo "--- crontab"; crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^#' | head; sudo crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^#' | head -20
echo "--- logs mtimes"; ls -l --time-style=full-iso /var/log/vps-*.log 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $6,$7,$9}'
for f in /var/log/vps-pipeline.log /var/log/vps-satellite.log /var/log/vps-ai.log; do [ -f $f ] && { echo "### $f"; tail -15 $f | cut -c1-220; }; done
echo "--- locks"; for l in $(ls /opt/weather-pipeline/*.lock /tmp/*.lock 2>/dev/null); do flock -n $l -c "echo FREE $l" || echo "BUSY $l"; done
echo "--- disk"; df -h / | tail -1; uptime
